description: This file defines the EmployeeDecorator class, which provides a wrapper and utility functions for the Employee entity, including formatting dates, setting and getting employee attributes, and referencing related entities.

classes.name: EmployeeDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for Employee entity that provides convenient accessors and mutators, especially for date formatting and related entity references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an Employee instance.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Protected method returning the wrapped Employee instance.

methods.name: getJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted join date of the employee.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseExpiredDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted driving license expiry date.

methods.name: getBirthday
methods.description: Returns the formatted birthday of the employee.

methods.name: getSmoker
methods.description: Returns whether the employee is a smoker as a boolean.

methods.name: setSmoker
methods.description: Sets the smoker status for the employee.

methods.name: setNationality
methods.description: Sets the employee's nationality by ID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the employment state of the employee (active or terminated).

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the first location associated with the employee.

methods.name: setLocationById
methods.description: Sets the employee's location based on location ID, replacing current location if changed.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the job title of the employee by ID.

methods.name: setEmpStatusById
methods.description: Sets the employment status of the employee by ID.

methods.name: setJobCategoryById
methods.description: Sets the job category of the employee by ID.

methods.name: setSubunitById
methods.description: Sets the subunit of the employee by ID.

methods.name: getFirstAndLastNames
methods.description: Returns the concatenation of the employee's first and last names.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the employee, including middle name.
